messages:
Dana (Collections): EchoPulse (acct EP-670) is past due on invoice 2026-05-16 for $57,600. They claim an SDK bug caused repeated streaming sessions and want full credit + a 120-day payment window. Asking for guidance before replying.
Rory (Finance): That's a big hit. We need CS verification and a conservative credit cap. No 120-day terms without board-level approval.
Priya (Acct Exec): Customer submitted logs showing duplicate session IDs from their worker fleet. CS thinks there9s something to investigate. They also say funds are tied up in vendor payments until next quarter.
Mina (Customer Success): I'm running a jobs audit now. Early look: ~28% of the tokens in the spike are from retried sessions flagged by user-agent "ep-sdk/1.2.3". Need another hour to confirm.
Lars (Legal): We can negotiate a one-time adjustment but must keep it capped and documented. Recommend we condition any credit on CS verification and a signed settlement agreement. Also replace vague "suspension" language with "temporary suspension of Dedicated capacity and API keys" if we need to enforce.
Rory (Finance): Propose: offer up to 30% one-time credit if CS confirms duplicate counting, require 50% payment within 5 business days, remaining balance over 45 days (two installments). Add 1.5% monthly finance charge for missed payments. No mention of 120 days.
Dana (Collections): Draft reply below. Quick review please.
Dana (Collections): ```Hi EchoPulse team 50, thanks for flagging this. We9ve started an internal review and CS is validating the session logs you provided. Pending verification, we can offer a one-time credit up to 30% of invoice 2026-05-16. To proceed we require: (1) signed payment agreement, (2) 50% of the outstanding balance within 5 business days, and (3) the remaining balance split into two equal installments over the following 45 days. Missed payments will incur a 1.5% monthly finance charge and may result in temporary suspension of Dedicated capacity and API keys. The credit is contingent on CS confirmation of duplicate/session-counting issues. Please confirm acceptance and provide payment method (card or wire). 50 Dana, Redwood Billing```
Mina (Customer Success): I can confirm duplicates in the subset they provided; looks like retries from their SDK and a mis-handled reconnect loop. I'll attach the CSV and a short verification note when I finish.
Priya (Acct Exec): If CS confirms, Finance will need the signed agreement and payment trace before we apply any credit. If they push back on 50% upfront, consider 40% with card on file and an auto-debit mandate.
collections-bot: Logged escalation: account EP-670 | balance $57,600 | potential credit up to 30% | payment plan proposed | follow-up 1802511600.
Rory (Finance): Agreed. No precedent beyond this one-time concession. Keep legal copied on all communications.
Dana (Collections): Sending with edits and CC billing@redwood + legal. Will update thread when I have Mina9s CSV and their reply. :hourglass:
